reason: #939 made ChatService.harness_knowledge_search async, but KnowledgeSearchTool still ran its searcher through asyncio.to_thread, so every provider-turn knowledge.search call failed with "'coroutine' object has no attribute 'matches'" and the model got a failed tool result instead of the project's excerpts. The tool now awaits an async searcher. Selected: test_knowledge_search.py (the changed tool and its provider-turn wiring, including a new routing-loop test and the two existing searches that failed on main), test_knowledge_index.py and test_knowledge_rerank.py (the retrieval harness_knowledge_search runs), the search-allowance cases that pass on main, the knowledge retrieval cases of test_chat.py, the harness gateway knowledge.search cases of test_harnesses.py (the sibling path through call_async, unchanged), and the routing-loop tests of test_chat_tool_loop.py that pass on main.
exclusions: Not selected because they fail identically on pristine origin/main: test_search_allowance.py's four loop cases (their _entries helper does not await the async _turn_history), test_chat_tool_loop.py's routing prose/thoughts/cancel/MCP-label cases, test_harnesses.py::test_knowledge_access_change_refreshes_fixed_gateway_catalog, and all of test_harness_provider_subagents.py (18 failures on main). test_chat_tool_loop.py::test_batched_safe_reads_overlap_and_commit_in_provider_order is timing-dependent and fails intermittently on main and the branch under host load. No UI, native or Playwright change: the fix is in Core's tool execution and was checked on a scratch PostgreSQL supervisor Core through POST /api/v1/chat/completions (knowledge.search ToolCall failed with the coroutine error on main code, completed with the runbook excerpt on this branch).
